sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the verified requirement with the authoritative ship and class-certificate ownership, required dates, canonical ice-class values, certificate draught envelope, document evidence, metre units, and corrected applicability and pre-/post-cutoff marking alternatives. Deterministic validation is valid.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Add explicit SHACL constraints for firstScheduledDryDockingDate (xsd:date), warningTrianglePresent (xsd:boolean), iceClassDraughtMarkPresent (xsd:boolean), and iceClassDraughtMarkDraughtAmidships (qudt:QuantityValue with decimal numericValue and unit:M), all on their authoritative ship owner. Constrain iceClass to the canonical iceClassValue range rather than only sh:nodeKind sh:IRI. In every applicable marking branch, require the amidships marking quantity to correspond to the class certificate's maximumIceClassDraughtAmidships; presence of a mark and a metre quantity alone does not encode the requirement's maximum-permissible-draught comparison. Preserve the existing assessmentDate-based conditional date logic while adding these missing datatype, unit, range, and cross-owner comparison checks.

Reject: the pre-cutoff due branch requires the warning triangle and ice-class draught marking whenever firstScheduledDryDockingDate <= assessmentDate, but it does not first require the source applicability condition that the summer load line fresh-water draught is above the UIWL. This incorrectly makes marking mandatory for pre-cutoff ships whose summer load line is not above the UIWL. Add the same summerValue > uiwlValue applicability test to the pre-cutoff due logic (while retaining the supplied assessmentDate and cutoff comparisons), and ensure the deferred alternative is selected only for the non-marked/incomplete-evidence case.

Repair the pre-1 July 2007 branch. Preserve the previously added authoritative ship-owner fields, canonical iceClass range, certificate/document requirements, metre quantity constraints, and mark-to-certificate maximum amidships comparison. The current logic has an accidental pass: when marking evidence is incomplete and firstScheduledDryDockingDate is absent, NOT EXISTS {?this nltl:firstScheduledDryDockingDate ?dockDate} passes instead of requiring the date. It also incorrectly rejects a future scheduled docking date because it requires dockDate <= assessmentDate even when marking is not yet due, and it can reject an inapplicable pre-cutoff ship (summer load line fresh-water draught <= UIWL) merely because a present docking date is not yet due. Encode the pre-cutoff applicability as summerValue > uiwlValue; when that condition is false, impose no marking/docking condition; when true, accept complete marking evidence without requiring a docking date, otherwise require firstScheduledDryDockingDate and require markings only if dockDate <= assessmentDate, allowing dockDate > assessmentDate. Keep the post-cutoff branch requiring complete warning-triangle, amidships-mark, and mark-to-certificate-maximum evidence only when summerValue > uiwlValue.

Candidate faithfully encodes the verified requirement with the authoritative ship and class-certificate ownership, required dates, canonical ice-class values, certificate draught envelope, document evidence, metre units, and corrected applicability and pre-/post-cutoff marking alternatives. Deterministic validation is valid.
